description.text:
The Emilia’s journey has at its heart the idea that simple, natural, comforting pasta should be affordable and enjoyed regularly by everyone who wants it. Everything relating to their food captures the essence of Italian cuisine – freshness & simplicity. 

Walking into Emilia’s Wood Wharf is like entering a bustling trattoria in Italy’s Emilia Romagna region with an ambience created by natural terracotta-plastered walls bathed in natural light, rustic Iroko furniture, creamy crema marfil marble counters and hand-painted Italian tiles. Chefs making fresh pasta greet diners at the window in a special dedicated custom-made area visible from all sides.

The thoughtfully designed interior cleverly combines a vibrant bar area with a custom table bocce for some competitive socialising in half the restaurant, with a cosy rustic restaurant section for more intimate moments and lingering conversations. The custom-designed kitchen and bar areas are fully open for diners to watch the theatrics of drinks and dishes being freshly prepared. Outside, alfresco diners enjoy views of the water and green open spaces as well as the stunning architecture of Wood Wharf.
